lines.text: Medication information is rarely in one place — and that makes care conversations harder than they need to be.
MediHuman brings those details together, so you can prepare clearer questions for a pharmacist or clinician.
Start with a prescription photo, or enter the details manually. Images are processed in your browser, and you stay in control of what you record.
Before anything is saved, review the capture against the original — including names, strength, and formulation. Uncertainty stays visible instead of becoming a silent assumption.
Then compare prescribed and dispensed lists. MediHuman surfaces what matches and what needs follow-up — without pretending to judge clinical appropriateness.
Your profile, medicines, prescriptions, comparisons, and questions stay organised in one workspace — ready for the next conversation.
If you choose to involve a clinician, access starts with a private patient ID and your approval. You can revoke it when you decide.
Underneath, the system is built for durable records, protected access, and clear boundaries. MediHuman: organise the information, then bring better questions to care.
